**Build passes now.** Two real bugs hid in the noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | Treat it as off |

The other 8 lines are true deprecation noise. Things like `Buffer()` and `punycode`. They do not break the build. Clearing them is a separate job if you want it.
